import json, subprocess, sys
sys.path.insert(0,"/workspace/dev")
import gen, gen2, gen3, gen4
from collections import Counter
stat = Counter(); conns = Counter()
for mod, n in ((gen,300),(gen2,120),(gen3,200),(gen4,119)):
    for s in range(1,n+1):
        doc = mod.gen(s)
        p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,"submission/main.py"], input=json.dumps(doc).encode(), capture_output=True)
        d = json.loads(p.stdout)
        for x in d["packets"]: stat[x["decision"]] += 1
        for j in d["jobs"]: stat["job:"+j["status"]] += 1
        stat["inputs"] += 1
        stat["packets"] += len(d["packets"])
        stat["conns"] += len(d["connections"])
        stat["noreport"] += 1 if d["reports"]["dev"]["connections"]==0 and d["reports"]["eval"]["connections"]==0 else 0
        for r in ("dev","eval"):
            if d["reports"][r]["connections"] > 0:
                mf = d["reports"][r]["macro_f1"]
                stat["macro_%s_%d"%(r, 0 if mf[0]==0 else 1)] += 1
print(dict(stat))
PYEOF
